## Benefits

We work hard, but we also know you have a family, friends, hobbies, and a life outside the office. That’s why we offer a great benefits package, not just a competitive salary.

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/pinpointhq/image/upload/c_fit,dpr_auto,f_auto,h_80,q_auto,w_auto/v1/careers_sites_templates/compose/production/k39yhsyqajyhurstwmni)

### Unlimited holidays

Everyone needs a healthy, happy, and productive life. This means you'll need time to rest and recover without restrictive holiday limits.

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/pinpointhq/image/upload/c_fit,dpr_auto,f_auto,h_80,q_auto,w_auto/v1/careers_sites_templates/compose/production/nbea8wn7rrvm25m9jfzh)

### Flexible, remote working

We want you to work when and where you're most productive, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl.

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/pinpointhq/image/upload/c_fit,dpr_auto,f_auto,h_80,q_auto,w_auto/v1/careers_sites_templates/compose/production/u3alago6bwwn2ecfncex)

### Gold plated healthcare

Enjoy the best medical, dental and optical coverage money can buy. We've got you and your family covered for all eventualities.

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/pinpointhq/image/upload/c_fit,dpr_auto,f_auto,h_80,q_auto,w_auto/v1/careers_sites_templates/compose/production/l9zdgmktnhk1fzfy3jdj)

### Meaningful equity

You’ll be contributing to the team's success, so you deserve to share in it. Everyone in our team gets a meaningful equity allocation.

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/pinpointhq/image/upload/c_fit,dpr_auto,f_auto,h_80,q_auto,w_auto/v1/careers_sites_templates/compose/production/doegfbjbow9jks5fxz4o)

### Top of the line equipment

We’ll set you up with the right tools to do your best work—starting with a MacBook Pro, 4K monitors, and the right software to get the job done.

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/pinpointhq/image/upload/c_fit,dpr_auto,f_auto,h_80,q_auto,w_auto/v1/careers_sites_templates/compose/production/loyv4hct1bhnogjhtfhw)

### A team that cares

You’ll be joining a team of smart, capable, helpful people that want you to win, our clients to be wowed, and our business to grow.

![](https://res.cloudinary.com/pinpointhq/image/upload/c_scale,dpr_auto,f_auto,q_auto,w_auto/v1/careers_sites_templates/compose/production/x5ditv89otkm8ko6uedl)

> “You’ll be joining a team of smart, capable, helpful people that want you to win, our clients to be wowed, and our business to grow.”

Sarah Smith, Marketing

## Cookie preferences

We use cookies to ensure the basic functionalities of the website and to enhance your online experience. You can choose for each category to opt-in/out whenever you want. For more details relative to cookies and other sensitive data, please read the full [privacy policy](https://haptiq.pinpointhq.com/en/cookie-policy).

Strictly necessary cookiesStrictly necessary cookies

These cookies are essential for the proper functioning of our website. Without these cookies, the website may not work properly.

| Name | Domain | Expiration | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| \_pinpoint\_session | pinpointhq.com | As soon as browser window is closed | Allows us to associate file uploads to our file storage provider with your form submissions |
| LSW\_WEB | haptiq.pinpointhq.com | As soon as browser window is closed | Allows our load balancer to send your specific traffic to the same backend server |
| LSW\_WEB | app.pinpointhq.com | As soon as browser window is closed | Allows our load balancer to send your specific traffic to the same backend server |
| cc\_cookie | haptiq.pinpointhq.com | Six months | Saves your decisions about these cookies so we don't need to ask every time |
